# Vettlo

> Vettlo is an independent publication that reviews business software for every team: sales, marketing, projects and operations, customer support, HR, finance, and IT and security. Scores are based on desk research of vendor pricing pages, documentation and verified user reviews.

Rankings are editorial only and based on published, weighted criteria per category. Vendors cannot pay for inclusion, position or scores. Sponsored placements are labeled and kept outside ranked lists. Reviews are re-verified every 90 days.

## Reviews
- [Best CRM Software for Sales Teams](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-crm-software/): shortlist of 7 CRMs scored on pipeline management, automation, reporting, integrations, usability and value
- [HubSpot vs Pipedrive](https://vettlo.com/compare/hubspot-vs-pipedrive/): list prices, plan features and year-one cost for a 10-rep team
- [Best Pipedrive alternatives](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-pipedrive-alternatives/): 6 CRMs for teams leaving Pipedrive, with what you gain and give up
- [Best HubSpot alternatives](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-hubspot-alternatives/): 6 CRMs for teams leaving HubSpot Sales Hub
- [Best CRM for small businesses](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-crm-for-small-business/): CRMs for teams of 1 to 20, weighted toward ease of use and price, with free-plan details
- [Best B2B Contact Data Providers](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-b2b-data-providers/): Six providers compared on coverage, phone data and how credits work.
- [Best ZoomInfo Alternatives](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-zoominfo-alternatives/): Five providers with published pricing or better mobile data.
- [Best Conversation Intelligence Tools](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-conversation-intelligence-software/): Four tools compared on coaching, deal insights, CRM sync and real price.
- [Best Gong Alternatives](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-gong-alternatives/): Three alternatives with published pricing and free trials or plans.
- [Best Sales Dialers](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-sales-dialers/): Six dialers compared, from power dialers to AI parallel dialers.
- [Best Aircall Alternatives](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-aircall-alternatives/): Five options with more dialing modes or parallel dialing.
- [Best Project Management Software](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-project-management-software/): Six tools compared on planning views, automation and real per-seat price.
- [Best Asana Alternatives](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-asana-alternatives/): Five tools for teams outgrowing Asana's free plan or pricing.
- [Best Sales Engagement Platforms](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-sales-engagement-software/): Outreach tools scored on sequencing, deliverability, data and price.
- [Best Apollo.io Alternatives](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-apollo-alternatives/): Five tools for teams outgrowing Apollo's credits or sending limits.
- [All categories](https://vettlo.com/best-tools/)
